message.content: Hunting for physics rule breaks — starting with broad randomized sweeps.
Found an energy violation — now shrinking it to a minimal case.
Replay confirms the violation — now inspecting the failure point.
I see the bodies nearly touching at the violation — checking earlier steps to trace the buildup.
Energy jumped ~14% around a collision — inspecting the steps just before to confirm.
I've traced the energy spike to an oblique high-speed collision — now testing a counterfactual with no restitution.
The zero-restitution variant passes — verifying its final momentum to pin down the cause.
